name: create_followup
description: Use for an explicit human request, a non-emergency clinical concern, an unmatched patient, repeated recognition failure, or another unsupported request. This creates a callback only. It also works in Bolna Chat without call_sid by creating isolated synthetic chat context. Never claim that a live transfer is happening and promise a callback only when this tool returns ok=true.

category.description: Use human_requested for a person, clinical_concern for a non-emergency medical question, and other for unmatched patients or unsupported requests.

call_sid.description: Use {call_sid} during real calls; omit in Bolna Chat.
